name: The Beautiful Game
source:
This game is a choice-based visual novel, where you take on the role of Zach, a fresh and naive graduate. He grew up in small town and had a sheltered upbringing, and is about to move to the sprawling metropolis that is Ocean City for his first ever job. Initially he will lodge with a family friend, a successful businesswoman, before moving into his own place.

Zach will face many of the wonders and temptations that can be found in a great city. His eyes will be opened, he will face many difficult - but interesting - choices, and he will gradually become a man. He will be encouraged, guided, and tempted along the way by a variety of wonderful characters.

Will Zach turn out to be a pure and innocent boy, the kind of boy mothers want their daughter to bring home? Or will Zach follow a slightly different path, one where he tries to bring a mother and daughter back to his home...

The story begins with Zach moving to Ocean City and starting his job as a sports scientist and sports massage therapist at Ocean City Football Club... the top women's football team in the country.

[From [url=https://daggum.itch.io/the-beautiful-game]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
这款游戏是一款基于选择的视觉小说，你将扮演扎克（Zach）的角色，一名天真的毕业生。他在小镇长大，受到庇护，即将搬到大洋城，开始他的第一份工作。最初，他将住在一位家庭朋友（一位成功的女商人）那里，然后搬到自己的住处。

扎克将面临大城市中的许多奇迹和诱惑。他的眼睛将会睁开，他将面临许多困难但有趣的选择，他将逐渐成为一个男人。一路上他会受到各种精彩人物的鼓励、引导和诱惑。

扎克会成为一个纯洁无邪的男孩，母亲希望女儿带回家的那种男孩吗？或者扎克会走一条稍微不同的道路，他试图将一对母女带回他的家……

故事始于扎克搬到大洋城，并开始在大洋城足球俱乐部（该国顶级女子足球队）担任运动科学家和运动按摩治疗师。

[来自[url=https://daggum.itch.io/the-beautiful-game]Itch.io[/url]]
